original.target_description: Experiment 2 identified, but the repeated generic description does not select uniquely among language-form omnibus, pooled contrast, and individual pairwise tests.

replication.target_description: Paper and authors supplementary pre-study report available. Supplied https://osf.io/nfskq is a file locator, but download returned HTTP 403; no retry. Neutral description repeated across 11 assigned IDs does not identify lab, pooled vs pairwise contrast, confirmatory vs extended pilot, or test. No mapping inferred from ID order.

notes: No statistics inferred or converted. Repeated identical descriptions are not assigned to labs or tests by input order. OSF nfskq node API returned 404 because this is a file; direct file download redirected to sqcrm and returned 403. Current manuscript has multiple candidate language-form tests and laboratory estimates; locator cannot select a unique one. Authors pre-study primary table was independently inspected but provides no identifier mapping for these 11 indistinguishable descriptions.
